name: Prism
author: jram0421
description: Control your PC's RGB lighting from the Omarchy bar. Sets motherboard headers, RAM, LED strips and fans to one color or a synced effect, matches your theme's accent, and turns off when the screen locks. Powered by OpenRGB.

barWidget.description: Bulb icon in the bar opens a panel to set your PC's RGB color, effect and brightness; right-click toggles the lights.
